title: AI Art Generation
summary: Learn how to create original digital artwork and visual concepts with AI image-generation tools.
what: Learn how to create original digital artwork and visual concepts with AI image-generation tools. The course introduces prompt writing, visual direction and techniques for producing images for creative, personal and commercial projects.
who: Beginners, digital artists, designers, content creators, entrepreneurs and anyone interested in AI-assisted visual creativity.
learn:
Understanding text-to-image generation and common image-generation settings.
Writing prompts that describe subject, style, composition, lighting, colour, mood and detail.
Exploring artistic styles, visual references and prompt refinement.
Generating variations and selecting suitable outputs.
Creating images for social media, branding, advertising and storytelling.
Understanding image quality, consistency, copyright and responsible use.
tools: ChatGPT image generation, Gemini, Leonardo AI, Ideogram and other suitable image tools.
practical: Create a themed image collection, social media artwork, campaign visual or concept-art series.
outcome: Produce original AI-assisted images and direct an image-generation workflow with clearer creative control.

title: AI Photo Editing
summary: Learn to enhance, retouch and creatively transform photographs using AI-assisted editing features.
what: Learn to enhance, retouch and creatively transform photographs using AI-assisted editing features. The focus is on improving image quality while preserving a natural, intentional result.
who: Photographers, content creators, designers, small-business owners and beginners who work with photos.
learn:
Image cleanup, background removal and object removal.
Photo enhancement, sharpening, upscaling and restoration.
Portrait retouching, lighting correction and colour adjustment.
Background replacement and image composition.
Using generative fill or expand features where available.
Preparing images for social media, product displays and promotional materials.
tools: Photoshop AI features, Canva, Photopea, Pixlr and mobile AI photo editors.
practical: Edit a portrait, improve a product photograph and create a before-and-after visual.
outcome: Edit and prepare professional-looking images for personal brands, products and digital content.

title: AI Music Production
summary: Explore how AI tools can support music creation, from generating musical ideas and lyrics to producing tracks for creative content.
what: Explore how AI tools can support music creation, from generating musical ideas and lyrics to producing tracks for creative content. Learners will understand how to guide a music-generation tool and refine outputs for a purpose.
who: Content creators, musicians, video producers, marketers and beginners interested in AI-assisted music.
learn:
Understanding AI music-generation workflows and prompt structure.
Describing genre, mood, tempo, instrumentation, vocals and song structure.
Generating song ideas, lyrics and instrumental tracks.
Creating variations and refining musical direction.
Preparing music for videos, adverts, intros and social media.
Understanding licensing, commercial-use terms and responsible publication.
tools: Suno, Udio and other available AI music tools.
practical: Create a short original music track or branded audio concept for a video.
outcome: Generate and select AI-assisted music suitable for a defined creative brief.

title: AI Video Creation
summary: Learn to turn ideas, scripts and prompts into short videos using AI video-generation tools.
what: Learn to turn ideas, scripts and prompts into short videos using AI video-generation tools. The course covers planning scenes, describing movement and visuals, generating clips and assembling a coherent sequence.
who: Content creators, social media managers, marketers, entrepreneurs and aspiring video producers.
learn:
Understanding text-to-video and image-to-video workflows.
Writing prompts for scenes, subjects, camera movement, lighting and visual style.
Creating shot lists and short scene sequences.
Generating and reviewing clips; refining prompts for better results.
Maintaining visual consistency across scenes where tools allow.
Combining clips into a story or promotional sequence.
tools: Runway, Kling, Google Veo/Flow and other suitable video-generation tools.
practical: Produce a short promotional video, storytelling sequence or social media video.
outcome: Plan and generate short AI-assisted video content for communication and marketing.

title: AI Video Editing
summary: Learn to edit video content efficiently with AI-assisted and conventional editing features.
what: Learn to edit video content efficiently with AI-assisted and conventional editing features. Students practise shaping raw clips into a clear, engaging final video.
who: Beginners, content creators, social media managers, educators and business owners.
learn:
Understanding the editing timeline, clips, tracks and sequence structure.
Trimming, splitting, arranging clips and improving pacing.
Adding titles, captions, transitions, overlays and effects.
Using AI-assisted captions, transcription, audio cleanup and reframing where available.
Adding voice-over, music and sound effects.
Exporting videos for different social platforms and aspect ratios.
tools: CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro and other suitable editors.
practical: Edit a short social media video with captions, sound and branded elements.
outcome: Edit and export polished videos for online publishing.

title: AI Prompt Engineering
summary: Learn how to communicate clearly with AI systems to get more relevant, structured and useful results.
what: Learn how to communicate clearly with AI systems to get more relevant, structured and useful results. The course develops prompt-writing skills that can be applied to text, images, video, research and business workflows.
who: Beginners, professionals, students, entrepreneurs, educators and creatives who want to use AI more effectively.
learn:
How generative AI systems interpret instructions and context.
Structuring prompts with role, task, context, constraints and output format.
Using examples, reference material and iterative refinement.
Prompting for writing, research, planning and problem-solving.
Prompting for image, video and creative generation.
Evaluating outputs, reducing ambiguity and checking factual claims.
tools: ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and other generative AI platforms.
practical: Build a reusable prompt library and complete practical prompts for different tasks.
outcome: Write clearer prompts, evaluate AI responses and adapt prompting techniques across tools.

Rendering and preparing 3D visuals for digital content.

outcome: Understand a basic 3D design workflow and produce simple 3D visuals or animations.

title: AI Voice-over Creation

Website planning, page structure and user experience basics.
Designing responsive layouts for desktop and mobile.
